DECISIONS (channel interactive, date -u at receipt). Insert the ticket
through decompose-spec mode=extend (orchestrate-build §2.4) with its

  (last-modified Sun, 27 Sep 2026 01:33:43 GMT; server: Google Frontend).

- All three are already fixed in current source on origin/main:

RULING H-1: "Insert one ticket, ahead of P37.62, whose single goal is
that the public site stops serving those three harmful items, today.

Preferred path: execute P34.17's owed republish leg (the honesty wave on
the 09-27 data) through its documented, scripted publish path. If
P35.38a's /data-collection/ page can ship in the same publish with no
extra risk, include it.

If P34.17's live leg is blocked by a prerequisite that cannot be cleared
inside this ticket, fall back to a minimal-delta publish of the
currently served 09-27 artifact:

- /editorial-standards/ replaced by the current-source honest version or

- the dispute promise replaced site-wide with the current-source

Use the same scripted publish mechanism either way. Never hand-edit
buckets or services outside the scripts.

Production mutations header: pre-state capture (served artifact identity
plus object list or digests), the publish, rollback (re-point to the
captured 09-27 artifact) and verification. I authorize this production
mutation now.

Acceptance:
- GET checks show none of the three harmful strings on /,
  /visual-language/, /editorial-standards/ or a sample of dossier and
  map pages;
- an object/digest diff against the pre-state shows nothing changed
  except the intended items;
- rollback has been shown to be executable (dry-run or a documented
  command);
- the run ledger records the before and after evidence.

Tell me before publishing if the path you choose would also ship any
other Round-11 change, so I can confirm it."

If blockedOn in CURRENT STATE still names the stack ("#495 does not
contain its base #494's head c062c6c"), re-check it first. A merge-up

Report back with the inserted ticket's ID, its Phase-4 review verdict,

RULING E-2: "Stop committing the generated projection, and stop gating
every records commit on its freshness. Write an ADR amending ADR-126:
  - `current_projection.py generate` output is no longer committed;
  - CI runs `generate` into a temp dir and fails only if generation

Agents that need the view run `generate --out <tmp>` locally.
Remove docs/build/reports/current/{current.json, CURRENT.md,
manifest.json, obligations-*.md, receipt.json} from the tree in one
commit. Keep the input files.
Before removing anything, find every reader: git grep for
reports/current, current.json and CURRENT.md across tools, tests,

perf_reuse.py records-path rules; memory_guard.py's policy. Repoint each

Acceptance: a records-only change no longer requires a projection
commit; the `docs` CI job is green on a records-only test commit; the
next 5 tickets' closes contain zero projection-regen commits (I'll

RULING E-4: "Write an ADR amending this repo's B3 §6 contract bounds:
- Byte budgets become **warnings**, not failures. That covers the 48 KiB

- Keep the **shape** checks hard: CURRENT STATE key order and
